title: ATM debit with missing or partial cash - support procedure
content: For the Call Sense Bank demo, record the non-sensitive amount, ATM location and cash actually received, then create a cash-dispute case. An agent reviews the synthetic entry; neither an immediate refund nor a fixed resolution time is guaranteed.
customer_content: Keep the amount, ATM location, time and any transaction reference for a cash-dispute request. Check the account entry through a secure channel and report missing or partial cash to support. A refund or fixed resolution time cannot be guaranteed.
